name: European Kindred
description: The European Kindred (EK) is a white supremacist prison and street gang founded in 1998 at the Snake River Correctional Institution in Oregon, primarily by David Patrick Kennedy. It operates primarily in Oregon, with an estimated 500 members. The gang is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, assaults, dog fighting, home invasions, hate crimes, and money laundering, and is known for violent initiation rituals.

sources.title: European Kindred — ADL Hate Symbols Database
